tables.description: Per-table schema detail: fields, indexes, and link target. Optional, so extractions written before this key existed still validate.

imex_specs.description: The import/export specification tables a text link points at, read only when some link declares DSN=. Every field of every row, because these column names are Access own and naming a subset is how a version difference would silently drop the layout that a text link with HDR=NO has nowhere else (backlog A17).

warnings.description: Something a person must act on, whether the fault is the kit's - a table that would not read - or the application's - an ActiveX control that cannot load.

notes.description: What the run chose to do, so a reader can weigh the evidence it produced: which optional tier was skipped, whether startup macros were allowed to run. These travelled as warnings, and the bundle counted a warning carrying no marker as an object that could not be read - so a clean managed acquisition reported two failures, every time (backlog A25). Optional, so extractions written before this key existed still validate.
